description: This bar chart illustrates the average entropy values across different AI models—CPDT-4, Claude, and Llama—using three different methods: Baseline, Source Info, and Direct Command. The horizontal axis represents the AI models, labeled “CPDT-4,” “Claude,” and “Llama” in that order, and is categorical. The vertical axis, labeled “Entropy Average Values,” represents a linear scale ranging from 3.5 to 6.0, with tick marks at 0.5 intervals. For each AI model, there are three bars representing the different methods; the bars are grouped, with “Baseline” in pink, “Source Info” in light blue, and “Direct Command” in turquoise. For CPDT-4, the “Baseline” bar reaches approximately 5.2, the “Source Info” bar reaches approximately 5.4, and the “Direct Command” bar reaches approximately 5.6. For Claude, the “Baseline” bar reaches approximately 5.0, the “Source Info” bar reaches approximately 5.3, and the “Direct Command” bar reaches approximately 5.5. For Llama, the “Baseline” bar reaches approximately 5.1, the “Source Info” bar reaches approximately 5.8, and the “Direct Command” bar reaches approximately 6.0. The bars are arranged in alphabetical order by AI model name, and no bars are visually emphasized.
